What we do

Biodiesel production.
A range of blends.

Different fuel applications call for different blends. Pines USA produces a range of biodiesel mixes using biodiesel derived from waste cooking oil.

Talk with our team about your intended use and required blend. We can discuss current availability, product information, and the next steps for your inquiry.

A connected operation

Recovery is where
the story begins.

Pines Solutions collects used cooking oil from food service businesses and operates Recovery Point. Pines USA gives that recovered resource a new purpose through biodiesel production.

Meet Pines Solutions↗
Common questions

Before your
fuel inquiry.

What does Pines USA produce?

Pines USA produces biodiesel in a range of blends. The biodiesel is derived from waste cooking oil. Contact our team to discuss specific blends and current availability.

How do I choose a blend?

Start with the requirements for your equipment and application. Review the manufacturer’s guidance and discuss the relevant product specifications with Pines USA. Blend suitability is application-specific.

How do I request pricing or availability?

Use our contact page or call (512) 640-9102. Pricing, quantities, and fulfillment arrangements are confirmed directly with our team.

Can I arrange cooking oil collection through Pines USA?

Our Pines Solutions division handles oil collection and recycling. It also operates Recovery Point for partners who bring their used cooking oil to Athens.
